Nepalese Unique Scout. Ignores [icon:CITY_UNIMPROVED] Mountains and [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_ROUGH_TERRAIN_TOOLTIP]Rough Terrain[/TIP] for [icon:Action_Showall] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SIGHT_TOOLTIP]Sight[/TIP]. Ignores featureless [icon:CITY_UNIMPROVED] Mountains for [icon:Action_Move] Movement. Can move on Mount Everest. Can [TIP:LOC_ABILITY_SHERPA_UNLOCK_DESCRIPTION]Claim Mountains[/TIP] within 5 tiles of one of your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlements[/TIP].

Activate on a [icon:CITY_UNIMPROVED] Mountain Terrain within 5 tiles of one of your [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement's[/TIP] City Centers. The Mountain is [icon:CITY_RURAL] Improved immediately with a Highland Power Station. If the Mountain is outside your borders, a path of tiles is claimed back to the [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_SETTLEMENT_TOOLTIP]Settlement[/TIP].
